- Initial release of yotta-humanize 0.1.0.
- Provides a Chinese text editing tool to detect and rewrite AI-generated writing style, using 24 deterministic rules, custom wordlists, and statistical metrics.
- Supports scoring, detailed analysis, changelog reports, prioritized rewrite suggestions, and automatic deterministic rewriting.
- CLI tools compatible with Windows, Linux, and macOS; outputs in plain text, Markdown, or JSON.
- Does not alter facts, data, or named entities, and preserves original intent and tone.
